tools.name: git
tools.why: repo-state.sh (used by continue and handoff) and the SessionStart hint read branch, upstream, worktree and dirty-file facts from git

tools.name: perl
tools.why: repo-state.sh bounds gh calls and .local/state-checks.sh with a perl alarm timeout (no GNU timeout on macOS)

tools.name: python3
tools.why: repo-state.sh and the SessionStart hint parse JSON with python3; without it open-PR and CI details are omitted and the hint stays silent

tools.name: gh
tools.why: repo-state.sh reports open PRs and main CI status for continue and handoff; without gh it reports GITHUB: unavailable

auth.name: GitHub (gh)
auth.why: repo-state.sh needs an authenticated gh to list open PRs and CI runs; without it continue and handoff mark those facts unverified
